title: 解释与举例

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：What I mean by that is [simpler explanation].
sentenceFrames.usage: 说完一个比较抽象的观点后，立刻用简单的话解释。这是好表达者的习惯。
sentenceFrames.example: I think the education system is broken. What I mean by that is it was designed for a world that no longer exists — it teaches kids to memorize, not to think.
substitutions: "I think people should travel more." → What I mean by that is _____.
"Social media is changing how we think." → What I mean by that is _____.
"Work-life balance is a myth." → What I mean by that is _____.
"English speaking is a different skill from English reading." → What I mean by that is _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：A good example of this is [specific case].
sentenceFrames.usage: 用一个具体的例子支撑你的观点。具体的例子 > 抽象的道理。
sentenceFrames.example: Most people overestimate what they can do in a day and underestimate what they can do in a year. A good example of this is learning a language — you won't see progress in one day, but after a year of daily practice, the difference is massive.
substitutions: "Technology makes life easier but also more complicated." → A good example of this is _____.
"The best ideas often come from unexpected places." → A good example of this is _____.
"Sometimes doing less is actually doing more." → A good example of this is _____.
你自己的观点：_____ → A good example of this is _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 用类比让复杂概念瞬间变清晰。好的类比比 10 分钟解释都管用。
sentenceFrames.example: Passive vocabulary is like having a huge library in your head but no catalog — you know the books are there, but you can't find them when you need them.
substitutions: "Learning to speak a language is like **learning to drive — at first you think about every move, but eventually it becomes automatic.**"
"A good conversation is like **playing catch — you throw the ball, they catch it and throw it back.**"
你自己的类比：_____ is like _____.

collocations.english: in other words / put it this way
my point is / what I'm trying to say is
that proves my point / case in point
a classic example / a textbook case
